7: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
40: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.
48: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
52: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
60: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.
68: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
105: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
106: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
